title: Revoke button looks identical to the primary grant submit
description:
**Found 2026-09-16 while reviewing PR #353 (mid-turn revoke).**

In `web/components/TurnGrantPanel.tsx`, the Revoke control reuses `authButtonClassName` — the same class as the "Replace turn grant" submit button — and sits outside the form's submit path. A person scanning the panel sees two identically-weighted buttons, one of which silently strips every tool from a running turn.

**What done looks like**
- Revoke is visually distinct from the primary submit action (destructive styling, or clearly secondary weight).
- Its label says what it does without reading the surrounding prose.
- The existing `turn-grant.test.ts` assertions still pass; this is presentation only, no payload change.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Blocked by 930da7: this component is not mounted anywhere in the app, so there is no on-screen button to restyle. Fix the mounting first; the styling decision should then be made against the real rendered panel rather than the source.
